title: Finnish Game Industry Report 2016
methodology: 140 surveyed companies out of 250; all largest companies included; other available sources used for the 2,750 industry estimate.
assessment: Authoritative historic total but explicitly includes entrepreneurs and employees working abroad, while excluding interns and freelancers. It gives an overseas share (around 18%), not a precise domestic headcount/FTE.
next_step: Retain as a worldwide Finnish-studio total; do not create a precise domestic 2016 observation.

title: The Game Industry of Finland Report 2018
methodology: 140 company interviews from October 2018 to February 2019, augmented by other sources; the interviewed companies were 63% of known companies and included all largest companies.
assessment: Reports 3,200 FTE total and says totals include entrepreneurs and people employed abroad by Finnish studios. No overseas number, so the domestic total cannot be isolated.
next_step: Keep 2018 as worldwide total only; do not derive domestic employment.

title: The Game Industry of Finland Report 2020
methodology: 134 studio interviews conducted October 2020-February 2021, supplemented by other sources. Interviewed studios represented 67% of approximately 200 studios and well over 90% of employment.
assessment: Reports a 3,600 FTE total including entrepreneurs and approximately 250 people employed abroad by Finnish studios. A 3,350 domestic figure is arithmetic only, because the overseas component is approximate and no independently stated domestic total appears.
next_step: If retained, label 3,350 as an approximate derived domestic FTE, not an explicit count.

title: The Finnish Game Industry Report 2022
methodology: 134 game-development-studio interviews, supplemented by a comprehensive review and other available sources; interviewed studios were approximately 58% of 232 Finnish studios and covered a clear majority of employees and nearly all turnover.
assessment: Decisive explicit domestic series point: approximately 3,700 FTE staff in Finland, plus 400 people in Finnish-owned studios abroad, with a 4,100 people total. Totals include entrepreneurs.
next_step: Add a domestic 2022 FTE observation and preserve the separate overseas component and worldwide total.

title: The Game Industry of Finland Report 2024
methodology: 71 game-development-studio interviews plus public-source employee data for 185 studios; the interviewees were about 26% of 270 Finnish studios but included all major studios.
assessment: Confirms the current explicit domestic point: approximately 3,800 FTE staff in Finland, plus 500 people in Finnish-owned studios abroad; total around 4,300 people. Totals include entrepreneurs.
next_step: Use as the preferred current domestic FTE source; do not convert the overseas people count to FTE.
